acs.text_first_line: The chart deploys rwb-document with the api and the worker that polls rwb-document
DocumentIntakeWorkflow and its five activities are deployed and resolve on the queue
The 15-minute Schedule is registered from configuration and no Quartz row exists
The feature flag is set per environment and its off state is safe
The dashboards and alerts cover intake volume, OCR failure rate and held items
The runbook covers a failed run, a held item and a re-run, and the rollback is rehearsed
